Checked again when the email is about to: Checked again when the email is about to go out, so a delayed win-back skips merchants who reinstalled.

Draft automation shows Activate. Active: Draft automation shows Activate. Active automation shows Pause. Paused shows Resume and Archive. Archived or canceled campaigns cannot be reactivated.
Draft broadcast shows Send now and Sched: Draft broadcast shows Send now and Schedule. Scheduled broadcast shows Send now and Cancel. Sending broadcast shows Pause sending. Paused shows Resume sending and Cancel.

Estimate audience shows the number you e: Estimate audience shows the number you expect.
Every message is logged under Email Mark: Every message is logged under Email Marketing → Send log, and on the merchant record.
Example: a win-back offer 3 days after u: Example: a win-back offer 3 days after uninstall. You press Activate, then every matching event sends it.
Example: announce a feature to every ins: Example: announce a feature to every installed MIDA merchant. You press Send now or Schedule.
From now on every matching merchant even: From now on every matching merchant event sends this email.
Go to Campaigns, pick the template, filt: Go to Campaigns, pick the template, filter by app, install status, plan and country, then press Estimate audience.
Go to Templates, make one email with blo: Go to Templates, make one email with blocks. No HTML needed.

The name is free: an event nobody listens to yet is still logged, and the studio offers it next time.

Results panel: Sent = delivered to provi: Results panel: Sent = delivered to provider, Failed = provider refused (see Recent failures), Skipped = no email, unsubscribed, or already emailed by this campaign.
Rules are copied inline onto the matchin: Rules are copied inline onto the matching elements when the email is sent, because Gmail and Outlook ignore most <style> rules. Media queries stay in a <style> tag.
Send a test to yourself first, then Send: Send a test to yourself first, then Send now, Schedule or Activate. Watch the Results panel and Send log.

Send at most once per merchant: Send at most once per merchant
Send button is grey or nothing happens:: Send button is grey or nothing happens: add a Template, a Subject, and check Estimate audience is not zero.

Sends the current draft with sample data: Sends the current draft with sample data
Set INBOUND_EVENTS_API_KEY in the app va: Set INBOUND_EVENTS_API_KEY in the app variables first; every call is refused until then.
Setup: pick the Template, leave From emp: Setup: pick the Template, leave From empty to use the company default. Fill Reply-To only if replies should go elsewhere.
Shops without an email or who unsubscrib: Shops without an email or who unsubscribed are always left out, even if they match the filter.
Shown after the subject in the inbox: Shown after the subject in the inbox
